messages:
maya (People Ops): Heads-up: our 401(k) provider is switching vendors over the weekend of May 2–4. Quick Q: do incoming rollovers or in-plan Roth conversions need to be paused?
liam (Payroll): Payroll cutoff for elective deferral changes is Apr 29 23:59 PT. Any submissions after that may not map correctly until the following pay cycle.
zoe (Benefits): Vendor says portal maintenance May 2 02:00Z through May 4 10:00Z. Transfers initiated before the window should be accepted but posting could be delayed.
maya (People Ops): OK — so advise employees: start rollovers before Apr 30 to be safe. What about conversions?
zoe (Benefits): In-plan Roth conversions require provider-side execution. Vendor recommends holding conversions until May 5 to avoid failures.
jamal (Legal): For compliance we need to log initiation timestamps and confirmation dates. Also include contact for escalation if a distribution is missed.
liam (Payroll): Note: catch-up contributions (50+) processed as deferrals; confirm new plan code mapping in payroll file. We'll run a validation file Apr 24.
vendorbot (PlanVendor): Notice: maintenance window 2026-05-02T02:00Z to 2026-05-04T10:00Z. Support available; some account updates may queue.
maya (People Ops): I'll draft a short employee message (payroll cutoff, rollover cutoff, conversions paused, who to contact) and circulate for review tomorrow morning.
zoe (Benefits): Quick FAQ item: HSA/FSA unaffected (they're separate vendors). Loans and active distributions may require manual handling  we'll add instructions.
